data.gender_notes: Charanraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Charanraj is derived from two Sanskrit words – Charan (footstep) and Raj (King). This name symbolizes the divine presence of a king who walks among us. In Hindu mythology, Charanraj is believed to be the name of various gods, including Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva. The name Charanraj carries the meaning “Footstep of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charanraj usually hope their child will grow to embody footstep of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charanraj total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
